description: Safely land one or many topic branches onto main via GitHub PR: inventory, commit leftovers, push, open/update PR, verify (hosted Actions if it actually ran, else a local gate), merge or squash (repo norm), sync local main, then delete local/remote branches only after main contains the work. Use when the user asks to merge/squash/commit/PR/push to main, land a branch, land multiple branches, clean up merged branches, or close out feature/fix/chore/slice branches. Never commit or push directly to main; never force-push main; never delete a branch until origin/main has it. GitHub Actions billing is not a merge blocker; do not make repos public to get free minutes.
